name: Cal Ai Migat
original_name: キャル・アイ・ミガット
source:
A first-year student just like the protagonist. He is a quiet person who doesn’t talk with anyone and always spends time alone, away from everyone else. He lost his family when he was young and was taken in by the Migat family, so he and Victor are step brothers, but they rarely speak to each other. Advanced magic which lets you control spirit beasts is one of his strong points and he often plays with them. He may seem to have a small stature, but he is actually a glutton.

‘I think you just need something to eat when you’re depressed.’

[Translated from [url=http://www.daisy-daisy.in/products/majyu/]the official website[/url].]
